scope: F_1layer int10 HLS inference core only; DMA, PS, bitstream, board excluded
target_part_status: PROVISIONAL test part xc7z020-clg400-1; final board not selected (see AGENTS.md)
tool_for_measured_numbers: Vitis HLS 2020.2 (on laptop; NOT installed on dev machine)

discrepancy_found.impact: immaterial (rounds to 88.58%); flagged not silently edited

latency_attribution.method: analytical cycle model reconciled to measured total; see docs/reports/hls_attention_bottleneck_analysis.md
latency_attribution.headline: context accumulation is the dominant CYCLE cost (~45.2% of measured), 8x the score-loop cycles despite equal MAC count, because context does not unroll its HD=8 lanes
residual_causes: runtime integer division in softmax normalization
pipeline fill/drain of short per-token loops

optimization.name: bit-exact context HD-unroll + cyclic v partition (factor 8)
optimization.isolation: separate file; frozen baseline transformer_top.cpp untouched
optimization.bit_exact_rationale: per-d accumulation Sum_j qattn[j]*v[j,off+d] preserved in ascending j; only loop-nest order changed; accumulator width and requant identical
optimization.functional_validation_status: VERIFIED by g++ C-simulation (native width): 16/16 golden, byte-identical to baseline top; AND VERIFIED by Vitis HLS 2020.2 C-simulation (ap_int widths): 16/16 exact
optimization.csynth_status: MEASURED (Vitis HLS 2020.2, 2026-09-25). See artifacts/results/hls_z7020_opt_ctx_measured_summary.json. NOTE: the synthesizable variant required #pragma HLS INLINE on attention0_row/attention0_kv/linear; it is MEASURED 2.007x faster but OVERFLOWS Z7020 BRAM (382/280 = 136%). The no-inline variant HANGS 2020.2 csynth.
optimization.projection_analytical_SUPERSEDED_BY_MEAS: The values below are the ANALYTICAL PROJECTIONS made before synthesis. They are retained for the record and NOT edited. The measured latency speedup (2.007x) falls inside the projected 1.654-2.358x range, but the projected assumption of Z7020 resource fit was WRONG: the measured core overflows BRAM. See the measured summary JSON.

projection_analytical.resource_direction: expected +DSP (up to ~7 more for HD-parallel context MACs) and possible +BRAM banking from cyclic v partition; ample headroom on baseline (DSP 18%, BRAM 37%, LUT 46%); MUST be measured

realtime_assessment.conclusion: optimization is necessary but NOT sufficient for continuous non-overlapping real-time; further head-level parallelism and softmax-division rework are required
